market.intro: Players from current leagues (API-Football) with per-90 metrics and positional percentiles, cross-checked against your squad.
market.errorTitle: Could not load the current market

status.tableMissingTitle: The league stats table does not exist yet
status.tableMissingDescription: Migration 022_league_player_stats.sql has not been applied in Supabase. Until then there is nowhere to store leagues: loading data first would waste API-Football quota.
status.noDataTitle: Your organization has no current leagues loaded
status.noDataDescription: The current market is fed by API-Football. A backend administrator loads leagues with the script below; each league costs requests from the provider's daily quota.
status.keyMissing: The backend has no API_FOOTBALL_KEY configured: it must be set before loading leagues.
status.keyOk: API_FOOTBALL_KEY is configured in the backend.
status.commandLabel: Command (run it first without --modo to see the plan and cost; it spends no requests):

table.title: Results
table.noResultsDescription: No player matches the filters. Try lowering the minimum minutes or adding leagues.

market.footnote: Percentile = rank within the pool (100 = best). Only computed with at least {{minutes}} minutes played and pools of {{pool}} players or more; percentages require {{attempts}} attempts. No league-strength adjustment: a 90th percentile in different leagues is not worth the same.
market.ageAsOf: Age according to the provider on {{date}}

sheet.radarDescription: Against {{pool}} eligible players in their pool
sheet.noPercentilesDescription: Played fewer than {{minutes}} minutes or the pool is too small: a per-90 rate with such a small sample is not reliable.

similar.description: Same position, per-90 metrics normalized within the position. Similarity 100 = identical profile; 50 = one standard deviation apart on average.
similar.empty: No comparable players: other players in the same position with enough minutes are needed.
similar.lowSample: This player has few minutes: similarity is still computed, but the profile may change a lot.
similar.noReason: Overall resemblance without shared standout traits.

compare.pickPrompt: Choose a player from your squad to compare with this candidate.
compare.noRoster: Your organization has no players in the squad.
compare.radarDescription: Each one against their own league and position; only metrics with a percentile for both
compare.radarEmpty: No metrics have a percentile for both players to draw the radar.
compare.noOwnMarketRow: Your player has no competition stats linked in the loaded leagues: there are no comparable metrics. Their own data sources are listed below.

reason.different_competition: Same per-90 definition, but different leagues: no strength adjustment.
reason.rating_league_dependent: The provider rating depends on the league.
reason.different_provider: Different sources: the definition may vary.
reason.provider_specific_metric: Only API-Football publishes it; your player's source does not.
reason.own_source_missing: Your player's source does not include this metric.
reason.candidate_missing: No data or insufficient sample for the candidate.
reason.own_no_competition_data: Your player has no linked competition stats.

compare.ownOnlyTitle: Data only available for your player
compare.ownOnlyDescription: API-Football publishes no physical tracking or video, so this is not compared with the candidate.
compare.gps: GPS: {{sessions}} sessions · {{distance}} km average · top speed {{speed}} km/h

notes.percentiles_within_own_competition: Each player's percentiles are within their own league and position.
notes.no_league_strength_adjustment: There is no measured league-strength adjustment: read cross-league differences with judgment.
